title: Wright Field engineers and strange hieroglyph-marked material

tellings.quote: people at places like Wright Airfield, which was responsible for recreating the German pulse jet engine in 1943, are talking about material they've never seen before with weird hieroglyphics

plain: Between about 1943 and 1947, people at Wright Field, an Army air base in Ohio, were reportedly talking about a material they had never seen before, marked with strange hieroglyph-like symbols. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, during a debate with a skeptic, pointing out that the same base rebuilt the German pulse jet engine, a simple jet engine design, in 1943. He tells it to suggest that engineers who were already experts at copying foreign technology were handling something stranger, even before the famous crash at Roswell in 1947.
